name: code-block
title: Code block
description: A code block card for json-render chats: the code the model writes, highlighted with Shiki, with the file name, line numbers, called-out lines, a wrap switch and a copy button.
docs:
Turn the card on in the chat (one line in each file, see the comments in them):

  features/chat/chat-catalog.ts:   CodeBlockCard: codeBlockCatalogEntry
  features/chat/chat-registry.tsx: CodeBlockCard: ({ props, loading }) => <CodeBlockCard code={props.code} language={props.language} filename={props.filename} highlight={props.highlight} streaming={loading} />

The model writes the code, so there is no API route and no API key.
